findings.title: Doctors Without Borders denounces Israeli strike on Gaza clinic
findings.location: Gaza City, MSF clinic near Al-Shifa Hospital, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: MSF reports two of its guards killed in an Israeli strike on one of its clinics on Friday. The organization reports 17 colleagues killed in Gaza cumulatively. Physical damage and any suspension of medical services are unverified; the two deaths likely correspond to the previously logged clinic-vicinity incident, not additional fatalities.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: two of its colleagues, both guards, were killed late Friday in an Israeli strike on one of its clinics
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting an attributed statement by the affected humanitarian organization

bounded_discovery_context.method: Anadolu Middle East index and direct article inspection after OCHA and WHO checks; compared against 24 authenticated prior heartbeat files.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: New identification of the two deceased as MSF guards and MSF attribution of strike to its clinic; previous finding gaza-20261127-wafa-177363-al-shifa-vicinity-casualties did not establish staff identity or a strike on the clinic.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Anadolu displays November 28 publisher date, while MSF statement refers to Friday November 27. Publication time and time zone not explicit. Original MSF statement on X not directly retrieved; MSF website and Palestine page inspected but no matching release located. Attribution is to MSF via Anadolu, not an unsupported social claim. No independent corroboration of clinic damage or service disruption. Do not aggregate casualties. Production not compared.

official_first_checks.result: Homepage recovered; latest situation report dated November 26 inspected, no newer report located.
